AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: This app tracks pantry groceries with expiry dates and keeps a shopping list. Operational Patterns: - Use 'queryExpiringItems' to find what expires today or tomorrow before suggesting meals or purchases. - 'addPantryItem' and 'addToShoppingList' infer category (and shelf life) from the item name via on-device AI when those arguments are omitted; pass explicit values only to override or when inference fails. Constraints: - Categories are limited to exactly: Frozen Items, Green vegetables, Dairy products, Dishes. - Pantry expiry dates must be tomorrow or later; an item counts as expired the day AFTER its expiry date.
